description: Sub-millisecond zero-dependency %PDF-1.4 vector document engine in Rust and TypeScript with Latin, Russian Cyrillic, and connected Arabic RTL support.
rules: Always pass exact integer minor units (e.g. 513000 for £5,130.00 or 1942500 for AED 19,425.00) to amount_minor and formatMoneyMinor; binary floats throw MsfPdfError('INVALID_SPEC').
Pass Arabic strings in standard logical UTF-8 order; msfPDF performs contextual Isolated/Initial/Medial/Final shaping, Lam-Alef ligatures, and UAX #9 BiDi visual reordering automatically.
Core TypeScript rendering (renderDocument, renderDocumentJson) has zero npm dependencies and runs identically in Node 22+, Bun, Deno, Cloudflare Workers, and browsers.
